fullDesc: Description Marked "MC14013BCP" on the package with Motorola's logo, this is Motorola's (now ON Semiconductor) MC14013BCP , a CMOS Dual D-Type Flip-Flop integrated circuit (part of the standard 4000 CMOS series, functionally equivalent to CD4013). Each flip-flop has independent Data (D), Clock (CLK), Set (S), and Reset (R) inputs, along with complementary outputs ( $Q$ and $\bar{Q}$ ). Logic states on the Data input are transferred to the $Q$ output on the positive-going edge of the clock pulse. Independent asynchronous Set and Reset inputs allow direct setting or clearing of the flip-flops regardless of the clock state. Key Specifications Type: CMOS Dual D-Type Flip-Flop IC Manufacturer: Motorola / ON Semiconductor Package Marking: MC14013BCP / FFE9648 Package: DIP-14 (14-pin dual in-line package) Supply Voltage Range ( $V_{DD}$ ): 3.0V to 18V Input Voltage Range ( $V_{IN}$ ): -0.5V to $V_{DD} + 0.5\text{V}$ Clock Frequency ( $f_{CLK}$ ): Up to 16 MHz at $V_{DD} = 15\text{V}$ (typ. 8 MHz at 10V) Propagation Delay Time ( $t_{PLH}, t_{PHL}$ ): ~65 ns at $V_{DD} = 10\text{V}$ DC Input Current ( $I_{IN}$ ): $\pm 10\,\mu\text{A}$ max Quiescent Power Dissipation: Ultra-low (typically $0.01\,\mu\text{W}$ per package at 5V) Operating Temperature Range: $-55^\circ\text{C}$ to $+125^\circ\text{C}$ Common Applications Frequency division / clock dividers (dividing digital clocks by 2 or powers of 2) Toggle switches and latching/memory logic circuits Shift registers and counter circuits Data storage registers and pulse synchronizers/shapers Package Includes 1 x Motorola MC14013BCP Dual D-Type Flip-Flop IC (DIP-14)

fullDesc: Description: This component is an N-Channel Power MOSFET (specifically, the MDF3752 made by MagnaChip ). Think of a MOSFET as an electronic switch . Unlike a mechanical switch that you flip with your finger, this switch turns on and off automatically using electrical voltage signals. How It Works Imagine a high-pressure water pipe: Drain & Source Pins: These act as the inlet and outlet for electric current to flow through. Gate Pin: This acts as an electric valve handle. When a small voltage signal is applied to the Gate pin, the valve opens wide, allowing a large electric current to flow between the Drain and Source pins instantly. Key Features & Specs Voltage Handling (250V): It can safely hold back up to 250 Volts across its switch pins when turned off. Current Capacity (43A): When fully turned on, it can switch high power levels carrying up to 43 Amperes of electric current. TO-220F Package: The fully plastic casing has a mounting hole at the top, allowing it to be screwed directly onto a metal heatsink to keep it cool during high-power operation without short-circuiting. Common Uses You will typically find this component in high-power electronics, such as: Switch-Mode Power Supplies (SMPS) (like inverter circuit boards or computer power supplies) DC-to-DC Voltage Converters Motor Speed Controllers & Drivers Power Amplifiers Package Includes: 1x MDF3752 N-Channel Power MOSFET

fullDesc: Description The HLF74HC147N is a 10-to-4 Line Priority Encoder IC manufactured by HLF, housed in a standard 16-pin DIP through-hole package. These high-speed Si-gate CMOS devices are pin-compatible with low power Schottky TTL (LSTTL) and are specified in compliance with JEDEC standard no. 7A. The 74HC147 accepts data from nine active-LOW inputs (A0 to A8) and provides a binary representation on four active-LOW outputs (Y0 to Y3). A priority is assigned to each input so that when two or more inputs are active simultaneously, the input with the highest priority is represented on the output, with input line A8 having the highest priority. The device provides full 10-line to 4-line priority encoding by using the implied decimal "zero" — the "zero" is encoded when all nine data inputs are HIGH, forcing all four outputs HIGH, meaning no dedicated tenth input pin is needed. This encoding function makes the 74HC147 especially useful for converting the output of a 10-position rotary or keypad switch into a compact 4-bit BCD code, greatly simplifying wiring and logic in code converters, keypad encoders, and digital control systems. Key Specifications Function: 10-to-4 line priority encoder (9 active-LOW inputs, 4 active-LOW BCD outputs) Logic Family: High-Speed CMOS (HC) Package: 16-pin PDIP (through-hole) Operating Voltage: 2V to 6V Operating Temperature: -40°C to +125°C Propagation Delay: ~160ns @ 2V / ~27ns @ 6V (25°C) Output Current: 5.2mA @ 6V Manufacturer: HLF Common Applications 10-position rotary/keypad switch encoding Code converters and BCD generators Priority-based digital input handling Keypad and control panel interfacing in digital systems Package Includes 1 x HLF74HC147N IC (16-pin DIP)

fullDesc: Description The SN74HC11N is a Triple 3-Input AND Gate IC manufactured by Texas Instruments, housed in a standard 14-pin DIP through-hole package. This device contains three independent 3-input AND gates, with each gate performing the Boolean function Y = A ● B ● C in positive logic — meaning each of the three sections outputs HIGH only when all three of its inputs are HIGH. Built on high-speed CMOS (HC) logic technology, this chip offers buffered inputs, a wide operating voltage range of 2V to 6V, and a wide operating temperature range of -40°C to +85°C, while supporting fanout up to 10 LSTTL loads — making it flexible enough to interface cleanly with both modern low-voltage logic and legacy TTL-based systems. It delivers fast average propagation delay of around 7ns with strong 24mA drive strength, giving reliable, low-power AND logic performance for demanding digital designs. With three independent AND gates on a single chip, the SN74HC11N is a compact, efficient building block for combinational logic design — commonly used for multi-input enable conditions, address decoding logic, control circuits, and general Boolean AND functions in digital systems. fullDesc: Description The SN74HC93N is a 4-Bit Binary Ripple Counter manufactured by Texas Instruments, housed in a standard 14-pin DIP through-hole package. These high-speed silicon-gate CMOS devices are pin-compatible with low power Schottky TTL (LSTTL) and consist of four master-slave flip-flops internally connected to provide a divide-by-two section and a divide-by-eight section. Each section has a separate clock input (CP0 and CP1) to initiate state changes of the counter on the HIGH-to-LOW clock transition. A gated asynchronous master reset (MR1 and MR2) is provided, which overrides both clocks and resets all flip-flops. Since the divide-by-two section isn't internally connected to the following stages, the device can be operated in various counting modes — by externally connecting output Q0 to input CP1 and applying the input pulses to CP0, the chip performs simultaneous frequency divisions of 2, 4, 8, and 16 at the Q0–Q3 outputs, giving a full 4-bit ripple counter. It can also be used as a standalone 3-bit ripple counter when needed. The 74HC93 supports a wide operating voltage range of 2V to 6V, making it flexible for use in both 3.3V and 5V logic systems, unlike its LS-series counterpart which is limited to 5V. This, combined with its low power CMOS design, makes the SN74HC93N a solid choice for frequency division, event counting, and general digital timing circuits in modern low-voltage designs as well as legacy TTL-compatible systems. Key Specifications Function: 4-bit binary ripple counter (divide-by-2 and divide-by-8 sections) Logic Family: High-Speed CMOS (HC) Package: 14-pin PDIP (through-hole) Operating Voltage: 2V to 6V Manufacturer: Texas Instruments Asynchronous gated master reset (MR1, MR2) Pin-compatible with LSTTL (74LS93) Common Applications Frequency division (÷2, ÷4, ÷8, ÷16) Digital event counters and timers Clock/timing circuits in digital systems Binary counting for display drivers (e.g., paired with 7-segment displays) Educational and hobbyist digital logic projects Package Includes 1 x SN74HC93N IC (14-pin DIP)

fullDesc: Description The 74HC153 is a Dual 4-Input Multiplexer IC built on high-speed CMOS (HC) logic technology, housed in a standard through-hole DIP package. The device features independent enable inputs (nE) and common data select inputs (S0 and S1). For each multiplexer, the select inputs select one of the four binary inputs and route it to the multiplexer output (nY). A HIGH on the enable input (E) forces the corresponding multiplexer output LOW, giving straightforward control over each section independently. Inputs include clamp diodes, which enable the use of current limiting resistors to interface inputs to voltages in excess of VCC, adding flexibility when working with mixed-voltage systems. The device offers non-inverting outputs, along with a separate enable input for each output alongside common select inputs, and complies with JEDEC standard no. 7A. With two independent 4-input multiplexer sections on a single chip, the 74HC153 is a compact solution for selecting and routing one of several data lines to a single output — a common requirement in bus multiplexing, data selection, control logic, and digital signal routing circuits. It's specified for operation from -40°C to +85°C and -40°C to +125°C, making it suitable for both general-purpose and more demanding temperature environments. Common Applications Data selection and bus multiplexing in digital systems Signal routing where two channels of 4-to-1 selection are needed Boolean function generation (can implement logic functions via multiplexer configuration) General combinational logic design and control circuits Package Includes 1 x 74HC153 Dual 4-Input Multiplexer IC

fullDesc: Description The HLF74HC04N is a Hex Inverter IC manufactured by HLF, housed in a standard 14-pin DIP through-hole package. This device contains six independent inverters, with each gate performing the Boolean function Y = A in positive logic — meaning each of the six sections simply outputs the logical inverse (NOT) of its input signal. The inputs include clamp diodes that enable the use of current limiting resistors to interface inputs to voltages in excess of VCC, making the chip flexible for interfacing with a range of input voltage levels. A balanced output allows the device to sink and source similar currents, giving reliable, symmetric switching performance in both directions. Being part of the high-speed CMOS (HC) logic family, it offers low power consumption combined with TTL-compatible speed, making it a popular choice for general logic inversion tasks in digital circuits. As a fundamental logic building block, the 74HC04 is widely used in oscillator circuits, signal inversion, logic level conversion, and general combinational logic design — a staple in both hobbyist projects and professional digital circuit design. A second USB Type-C connector handles power and programming, with the usual drag-and-drop UF2 flashing over USB mass storage. fullDesc: Description The SN74LS125N is a Quadruple Bus Buffer with 3-State Outputs, manufactured by Texas Instruments and housed in a standard 14-pin DIP through-hole package. This device contains four independent non-inverting buffer gates, each with an individual active-LOW enable input controlling its 3-state output. When enabled, the outputs exhibit the low-impedance characteristics of a standard TTL/LS output, with additional drive capability that allows the buffers to drive bus lines directly, without needing external pull-up resistors. When disabled, each output goes into a high-impedance ("3-state") condition, effectively disconnecting it from the bus — a key feature for designs where multiple devices need to share a common data or address bus without conflict. This makes the SN74LS125N a common choice for bus interfacing, tri-state data bus control, memory and I/O bus isolation, and any digital system where signal lines must be selectively enabled or floated. Key Specifications Function: Quad non-inverting buffer with 3-state outputs (negative/active-LOW enable) Logic Family: TTL, Low Power Schottky (LS) Package: 14-pin PDIP (through-hole) Output Type: 3-state, high drive capability for bus lines Manufacturer: Texas Instruments Common Applications Tri-state bus buffering and isolation in microprocessor systems Memory and I/O bus interfacing Signal line enabling/disabling in shared bus architectures General digital logic buffering in TTL-based designs Package Includes 1 x SN74LS125N IC (14-pin DIP)

fullDesc: Description The SN74LS42N is a 4-Line BCD to 10-Line Decimal Decoder manufactured by Texas Instruments, housed in a standard 16-pin PDIP through-hole package. These monolithic BCD-to-decimal decoders consist of eight inverters and ten four-input NAND gates, with the inverters connected in pairs to make BCD input data available for decoding by the NAND gates. Full decoding of valid input logic ensures that all outputs remain off for all invalid input conditions, giving reliable, predictable behavior even with unexpected input states. The SN74LS42's inputs and outputs are compatible for use with most TTL and other saturated low-level logic circuits, with DC noise margins typically around one volt, making it easy to integrate into existing TTL-based digital designs. It decodes BCD inputs into corresponding decimal outputs, enabling accurate numeric display on 7-segment displays and simplifying the process of driving numerical displays in digital systems. Key features include multifunction capability, mutually exclusive outputs, demultiplexing capability, and input clamp diodes that limit high-speed termination effects. fullDesc: Description The SN74LS95N is a 4-Bit Parallel-Access Shift Register manufactured by Texas Instruments, housed in a standard 14-pin DIP through-hole package. It supports both serial and parallel synchronous operating modes, with the serial shift-right and parallel-load functions activated by separate clock inputs that are selected via a mode control input. This flexibility makes the SN74LS95N a versatile building block for data storage, serial-to-parallel or parallel-to-serial conversion, and general shift-register applications in digital logic circuits. Beyond parallel load and serial shifting, the chip also supports a hold mode that maintains the current register state without altering the stored data, which is useful for pausing data movement mid-operation without losing the current values. Its dual clock/mode-select architecture makes it straightforward to integrate into counters, data buffering circuits, and communication interfacing where controlled bit-shifting is required. fullDesc: Description The 74LS155 is a Dual 2-to-4 Line Decoder/Demultiplexer IC in the TTL Low-Power Schottky (LS) logic family, housed in a standard 16-pin DIP through-hole package. It features two 1-of-4 decoder/demultiplexer sections with common binary-address inputs and individual strobe (enable) inputs, allowing each 4-bit section to be activated or inhibited independently. When both sections are enabled via their strobes, the common address inputs sequentially select and route the associated input data to the appropriate output of each section. A useful design detail: data applied to input C1 is inverted at its outputs, while data applied at input C2 passes through true — the inverter on the C1 data input allows the chip to also be configured as a 3-to-8-line decoder or 1-to-8-line demultiplexer without needing external gating. Input clamping diodes are included to minimize transmission-line effects and simplify system design. The individual strobes also make it easy to cascade multiple chips together for decoding or demultiplexing larger data words. This flexibility makes the 74LS155 a popular building block in classic digital logic design, memory address decoding, data routing, and multiplexer/demultiplexer circuits. fullDesc: Description The SN74LS192N is a synchronous, positive-edge-triggered, 4-bit bidirectional decade counter IC in TTL logic, manufactured by Texas Instruments and housed in a standard 16-pin PDIP through-hole package. fullDesc: 330µF 25V Radial Electrolytic Capacitor This is a 330µF, 25V radial-lead electrolytic capacitor , ideal for filtering, decoupling, and energy storage applications in a wide range of electronic circuits. As an aluminum electrolytic type, it offers high capacitance in a compact form factor, making it a staple component for power supply smoothing, audio circuits, and general-purpose DC filtering. fullDesc: UNI-T UT197 Industrial Digital Multimeter — True RMS, 600,000 Counts, IP67 The UT197 is a rugged, high-precision handheld multimeter built for demanding industrial environments. With a 600,000-count display and True RMS measurement, it delivers accurate readings even on distorted or noisy waveforms — making it a reliable choice for professionals working in power construction, equipment maintenance, petrochemical, HVAC, new-energy, and factory or lab settings. Built to IP67 standards and rated for drops of up to 5 meters, this meter shrugs off dust, water, and rough handling. It operates reliably across a wide -40°C to 55°C temperature range, so it's just as much at home outdoors on a job site as it is on a bench. A built-in VFD anti-interference startup mode filters out carrier-frequency and distorted-voltage noise, giving you stable readings even when measuring near variable frequency drives. For safety, the UT197 is certified to CAT IV 1000V — the highest overvoltage category — along with CE and cETLus certification, and features 12kV pulse protection with anti-EMC interference shielding. Bluetooth connectivity lets you pair with the UNI-T SmartTest APP to log, graph, and tabulate your measurements, while optional external current clamps (UT-CS07) extend current measurement up to 1000A AC/DC. Active isolation gives safe, accurate differential readings. Genuine UNI-T accessory supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty. Key Features 🔀 HV differential — safe on floating signals 📡 100 MHz , 10:1 / 100:1 ⚡ 1500 Vpp , CAT III rated 🔋 Active probe with power supply/adapter Technical Specifications Bandwidth 100 MHz Attenuation 10:1 / 100:1 Max differential voltage 1500 Vpp Safety rating CAT III Type Active differential What's in the Box UT-P31 HV differential probe Power adapter Accessory kit Downloads UNI-T UT-P31 Product Page Certifications: CE | HS Code: 9030.90

The UNI-T UT-P30 is a 100 MHz active differential oscilloscope probe with switchable 10:1 / 100:1 attenuation and an 800 Vpp (CAT III) rating — for safely measuring floating and differential signals in power electronics, inverters and motor drives. Isolates the measurement from ground for accurate, safe differential readings. Genuine UNI-T accessory supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty. Key Features 🔀 Differential measurement — safe on floating/non-grounded signals 📡 100 MHz , switchable 10:1 / 100:1 ⚡ 800 Vpp , CAT III rated 🔋 Active probe with power supply/adapter Technical Specifications Bandwidth 100 MHz Attenuation 10:1 / 100:1 Max differential voltage 800 Vpp Safety rating CAT III Type Active differential What's in the Box UT-P30 differential probe Power adapter Accessory kit Downloads UNI-T UT-P30 Product Page Certifications: CE | HS Code: 9030.90

The UNI-T UT-P21 is a high-voltage passive oscilloscope probe with 1000:1 attenuation and 50 MHz bandwidth, rated to DC 15 kV / AC 10 kV rms — for safely viewing high-voltage waveforms in power electronics, ignition, plasma and HV research. Terminates in a standard BNC on a 2 m lead. Genuine UNI-T accessory supplied by Digilog.pk with warranty. Key Features ⚡ DC 15 kV / AC 10 kV rms high-voltage rating 📡 50 MHz bandwidth, 1000:1 attenuation 🔌 Standard BNC , 2 m lead 🛡️ Insulated HV body for safe measurement Technical Specifications Bandwidth 50 MHz Attenuation 1000:1 Max voltage DC 15 kV / AC 10 kV rms Connector BNC Cable length 2 m What's in the Box UT-P21 high-voltage oscilloscope probe Accessory kit Downloads UNI-T UT-P21 Product Page Certifications: CE | HS Code: 9030.90

The UNI-T UT-P05 is a 200 MHz passive oscilloscope probe with switchable 10:1 / 1:1 attenuation, rated 600 Vpp (CAT II 300 V) — for higher-bandwidth bench oscilloscopes up to 200 MHz. Standard BNC connector, 1.3 m cable and compensation adjustment. Genuine UNI-T accessory supplied by Digilog.pk. Standard BNC connector, 1.3 m cable and compensation adjustment. Genuine UNI-T accessory supplied by Digilog.pk.
